name: Amphibious Hands
details: Underwater mining x1.25 (+25%). Does not provide underwater breathing.

name: Blaze Nucleus
details: Reduces fire damage by 50%; qualifying enemy hits ignite for 4s and extinguish the wearer.

name: Blindfold
details: Enabled; no configurable numeric strength in its Stats class. Not a guarantee that every hostile mob loses its target or stops attacking.

name: Broken Ankh
details: 36,000-tick cooldown = 30 min. Has a configurable recharge cooldown; it is not continuously available.

name: Callus
details: 10% fall-damage reduction; 5% other damage reduction; listed hazard damage is zeroed. These are separate branches, not a combined 15% fall reduction. Damage reductions are configurable; this is not general invulnerability.

name: Creeper Sense
details: Sneaking triggers a power-3 explosion on a 12s cooldown. No block destruction; the wearer can still be hurt. Party allies and their pets are protected.

name: Dark Nelumbo
details: Lava-damage cancellation enabled by default. Its configuration includes a lava-damage cancellation option; do not assume this protects against every fire source.

name: Dragon's Eye
details: 20-block search range; blindness enabled. The configuration also enables blindness by default. This can explain an unexpected darkened view.

name: Eclipse Ashes
details: Taking an enemy hit summons phantom wolves for 5s, spaced 1s apart. Each deals 1 damage plus 5% of your strongest offensive power, capped at 3. New sessions have a 12s interval; hits do not extend the session.

name: Experience Battery
details: +50% qualifying kill XP, approximately x1.5 total before rounding. Does not promise a bonus to every XP source, such as mining or furnaces.

name: Experience Magnet
details: 25-block configured attraction range. Does not attract dropped items by itself.

name: Explosion-proof Jacket
details: Reduces explosion damage by 20%; awards at most 1 TNT every 20s from qualifying explosion events.

name: Fate Emerald
details: Trade discount boost 25 (raw value, not a guaranteed 25% discount). Retains 60s removal lock and 0.1 exhaustion per second.

name: Fertilizer
details: Growth interval 100 ticks = 5 s. Uses a configurable interval; it is not instantaneous growth for every plant.

name: Four Leaf Clover
details: Eligible non-player kills have a 25% chance of one extra loot-table roll. Not guaranteed duplication of original drops.

name: Fractured Nullstone
details: Reduces recognized magic damage by 15%, leaving 85% before other defenses.

name: Fragile Cloud
details: Gravity modifier -0.07 while qualifying descent is active; resets fall distance. No configurable numeric Stats fields. Its handler yields when Moon Stone is equipped; elytra flight, grounded movement and water have separate handling.

name: Ghast Eye
details: Adds 7.5% of maximum HP before the three scaling health accessories and Health Boost, capped at +6 HP. Kills refresh Regeneration I for 5s without adding duration; stronger unrelated regeneration remains.

name: Gills
details: Air decreases by 7 per tick outside suitable water; choking hit 2 HP (1 heart); choking blindness enabled; underwater air resets to 300. Air drains outside water and can cause choking and blindness. Normal removal requires the wearer's eyes to be underwater.

name: Ice Cube
details: Slowness I for 100 ticks (5 s); Frost Walker setting 1; unchanged freezing-immunity option enabled. Slowness strength/duration and freezing behavior are configurable; the source also includes a freezing-immunity setting.

name: Light Gloves
details: Mining x1.5 (+50%) while unable to see the sky. A roof can satisfy this check; the condition is not simply being below a fixed Y level.

name: Lucky Rock
details: 5% configured reward chance; eligible blocks and rewards are configured lists. Both eligible blocks and reward items are configured lists; not every mined block qualifies.

name: Miner's Soul
details: +1 Fortune level for eligible block loot; skips Silk Touch. The handler skips Silk Touch and block-entity blocks; it is not an extra Looting level for mob kills.

name: Missing Page
details: Taking sourced enemy damage releases a 5-block burst for 1 damage plus 10% of your strongest offensive power, capped at 6 per target. 4s interval; no boss-HP scaling.

name: Moon Stone
details: Gently lowers gravity and prevents fall damage. Gravity reduction is 3/8 of the old effect (-0.02625; ordinary gravity becomes 0.05375).

name: Nelumbo
details: Water-walking enabled; no configurable numeric strength in Stats. Does not supply breathing or faster underwater mining.

name: Puffer Fish Liver
details: 100% poison application on eligible targets; Poison I for 60 ticks (3 s). Poison-immune creatures remain immune. Poison chance, strength and duration are configurable; poison immunity is not immunity to all negative effects.

name: Rage Mind
details: Deal +10% damage against the marked creature type; existing marking and range conditions remain.

name: Resonant Heart
details: Enemy hits have exactly a 10% chance to trigger a sonic retaliation for 2 damage plus 15% of your strongest offensive power, capped at 8. 6s interval.

name: Reverse Card
details: Enemy hits have exactly a 25% chance to reflect 25% of incoming damage. Reflected damage is capped at 2 plus 10% of your strongest offensive power, never above 6. 4s interval; does not cancel the incoming hit.

name: Scarab Amulet
details: Movement on sand +30% (1.3x); husk targeting protection retained.

name: Shrinking Veil
details: Movement x1.25 (+25%); scale x0.75 (-25%); Weakness II refreshed to 1,200 ticks (60 s). Weakness can remain for up to 60 seconds after unequipping. It does not provide invisibility.

name: Sigil Of Baphomet
details: Kills add 0.5s of damage immunity, banked up to 2s. Stored legacy counts are clamped to the current cap.

name: Sleeping Pills
details: Phantom range 2 blocks; night-vision and weakness durations 1,200 ticks (60 s), refreshed by equipped behavior; bed sleeping disabled. Also applies Weakness and, by default, prevents sleeping in beds.

name: Spider Legs
details: Climb-speed setting 0.1 (raw movement value, not 10% speed). Climb speed is configurable; this is not free flight.

name: Tear Of The Sea
details: +0.5 water-movement-efficiency attribute (configured as 50%); not a guaranteed +50% final swim speed. Does not supply underwater breathing by itself.

name: Tick
details: Once per second, drains eligible non-player enemies within an 8-block sphere for 1 damage plus 10% strongest offensive power, capped at 6 per target. Targets must have over 50 maximum HP and be above half HP. Each successful pulse costs the wearer 5% maximum HP, or exhaustion equal to 10% current food when below 5 HP. Own and party pets are protected. Normal removal still requires being on fire; creative bypass retained.

name: Titan's Mark
details: Size +25%, attack damage +5%. Adds 15% of maximum HP before the three scaling health accessories and Health Boost, capped at +10 HP. Refreshes Resistance I for 5s and Slowness I for 60s; no healing on equip or refresh.

name: True Heart Of The Sea
details: Underwater mining x1.25 (+25%); other water and land-breathing effects unchanged: +1 water-movement efficiency, 1.5-HP choking damage, air drain 5/tick. The wearer loses air on land and can choke and receive blindness. Treat it as a water-specialist item with a land-breathing drawback.

name: Vampire Blood
details: Attack damage +10%; movement speed +10%. Enemy kills heal 2 HP plus 5% of wearer maximum HP, capped at 4 HP, once per 2s. Sunlight damage remains 2 HP. Removal stays locked for 48,000 equipped ticks (two full Minecraft days); offline time and sleep skips do not advance it.

name: Wooden Stick
details: Recharge 200 ticks = 10 s. Recharge cooldown prevents it from blocking every incoming hit.

name: Woundbearer
details: Stores 1% of damage taken as extra attack damage. Storage limit is 10% of melee power before Power Glove and Woundbearer, capped at +4 effective attack damage. Decay starts after 3s with base decay 0.01 per tick; legacy storage is clamped.

name: Plastic Drinking Hat
details: **+150% drinking speed** and **+50% eating speed**. These are speed increases, not equivalent reductions in consumption time.

name: Novelty Drinking Hat
details: **+150% drinking speed** and **+50% eating speed**. Same default bonuses as Plastic Drinking Hat; extra flavor text is not another combat bonus.

name: Snorkel
details: **Water Breathing I for 30 seconds**, replenished while recovering air. **Infinite underwater breathing is disabled** by default.

name: Night Vision Goggles
details: Toggleable **NIGHT VISION**, reduced to brightness strength **0.15 (15%)**. This is visual strength, not activation chance.

name: Villager Hat
details: **+75 villager reputation points**, affecting reputation-based trading. This is **not a guaranteed 75% discount**.

name: Superstitious Hat
details: **+1 Looting level** for applicable drops, not generic Luck.

name: Cowboy Hat
details: **+40% base mount movement speed** while riding.

name: Angler's Hat
details: **+1 Luck of the Sea** and **+1 Lure level** for fishing.

name: Lucky Scarf
details: **+1 Fortune level** for applicable block drops, not generic Luck.

name: Scarf of Invisibility
details: Toggleable **INVISIBILITY**. Defaults do not hide its own model when invisible or hide effect particles.

name: Cross Necklace
details: Adds 10 invulnerability ticks (0.5s) after taking damage; native cooldown 5s.

name: Panic Necklace
details: After being hurt, grants **Speed I for5s**; **7s cooldown**.

name: Shock Pendant
details: 25% chance to retaliate against an eligible attacker under open sky. Visual lightning accompanies 2 damage plus 10% of strongest offensive power, capped at 6. 6s cooldown. Retains lightning immunity; no collateral lightning damage or fire.

name: Flame Pendant
details: 40% chance to ignite an eligible attacker for 4s, granting the wearer Fire Resistance I for 4s. 4s cooldown; allies and accessory retaliation are excluded.

name: Thorn Pendant
details: 50% chance to retaliate for 1 damage plus 10% wearer armor, capped at 4 damage. Fixed 4s interval; excludes allies and cannot trigger retaliation chains.

name: Charm of Sinking
details: Toggleable **SINKING** in water, **+1.5 oxygen bonus attribute**, and prevention of underwater fall damage. Oxygen is a raw attribute bonus, not a verified direct breath-duration multiplier.

name: Charm of Shrinking
details: Toggleable **75% original size**, **1.2x movement speed** and refreshing **Weakness II for60s** while active. Native Artifacts effect padding adds19ticks to the refreshed duration; unequipping uses native cleanup.

name: Cloud in a Bottle
details: **DOUBLE JUMP**, **+3 blocks safe fall distance**. Double jump resets accumulated fall distance; default multiplier **0.0** avoids damage for the fall accumulated before that jump. The subsequent fall still matters. Sprint double jump: **+25% vertical launch velocity**, **+0.25 horizontal velocity**.

name: Obsidian Skull
details: After fire damage, grants **Fire Resistance II for30s** with a **60s cooldown**. Vanilla levelII gives no stronger fire protection than levelI; it does not retroactively cancel the triggering hit.

name: Antidote Vessel
details: Caps supported finite harmful-effect duration at **5 seconds**: **POISON**, **WITHER**, **WEAKNESS**, **SLOWNESS**, **BLINDNESS**, **NAUSEA**, **MINING FATIGUE**, **HUNGER**, **LEVITATION**. Internal cooldown **2 seconds**. Infinite effects are excluded. Cap **0** removes applicable finite effects.

name: Universal Attractor
details: Toggleable **Magnetism V** pulls dropped items. Search box extends **5 blocks in each axis**, capped at **10** at higher levels; not a spherical radius. Excludes pickup-delayed items and items marked as thrown by wearer.

name: Crystal Heart
details: Adds 10% of maximum HP before the three scaling health accessories and Health Boost, capped at +8 effective HP. No healing on equip or refresh; cannot amplify the other scaling health curios.

name: Helium Flamingo
details: **SWIM THROUGH AIR for 8 seconds**, **15-second recharge duration**, **3-second cooldown**. Limited flight.

name: Chorus Totem
details: Consumed death protection: clears effects, attempts a teleport within 32 blocks and restores 25% of current maximum HP, capped at 16 HP. Native rescue consumption and other effects remain.

name: Warp Drive
details: Ender-pearl use costs **2 hunger points (1 drumstick)** instead of consuming the pearl when enough food is available; otherwise normal pearl consumption applies. **Pearl teleport damage canceled** by default; extra artifact cooldown **0 seconds**.

name: Digging Claws
details: **+30% base block-breaking speed**, with a **stone-tier tool upgrade** for applicable mining. Does not grant diamond/netherite harvesting capability.

name: Feral Claws
details: +10% base attack speed.

name: Power Glove
details: Adds 5% of melee power before Power Glove and Woundbearer, capped at +2 effective attack damage. Recalculates as outside equipment and buffs change.

name: Fire Gauntlet
details: +4 seconds attack-burning duration.

name: Pocket Piston
details: **+0.3 attack knockback**; this is a raw attribute amount, not30% damage.

name: Vampiric Glove
details: Basic melee hits heal 5% of actual health damage, capped at 2 HP, once per 1s. Overkill and absorption do not increase healing; allies and accessory retaliation cannot trigger it. Healing-received modifiers remain native.

name: Golden Hook
details: **+50% entity experience** from applicable kills, not every XP source.

name: Onion Ring
details: After eating: **Haste II**, **6 seconds per hunger point actually restored**. Hunger that could not be restored does not count.

name: Pickaxe Heater
details: **AUTO-SMELTS** applicable mined ore drops with matching recipes. Not an automatic furnace for every block.

name: Withered Bracelet
details: Melee hits have a 30% chance to apply Wither I for 4s. 4s cooldown shared by the wearer; excludes allies and accessory retaliation.

name: Aqua-Dashers
details: Allows **SPRINTING ON WATER**, not lava.

name: Bunny Hoppers
details: **+40% base jump strength**, **+10 blocks safe fall distance**, rabbit hurt sounds. Here `fallDamageMultiplier = 0.0` is an additive base modifier: **no extra multiplier change**, not complete fall immunity.

name: Kitty Slippers
details: **REPELS CREEPERS** and **PHANTOMS**, plus cat hurt sounds. Does not repel every hostile mob.

name: Running Shoes
details: +15% base movement speed while sprinting; retains +0.5 block step height.

name: Snowshoes
details: **+30% base movement speed on snow**, **WALK ON POWDER SNOW**.

name: Steadfast Spikes
details: +30% knockback resistance and +1 slip resistance. Fits the restored Feet slot, separate from Nameless Shoes.

name: Flippers
details: **+70% base swim speed**.

name: Rooted Boots
details: While grounded on supported grass and hungry: **1 hunger point per 10-second interval**, with saturation. Eating while grounded on supported grass can **GROW PLANTS** using bone-meal behavior.

name: Strider Shoes
details: **WALK ON LAVA while sneaking**; prevents hot-floor damage such as magma blocks. Not blanket immunity to every fire/lava damage source.

name: Whoopee Cushion
details: **+0.12 (12 percentage points) FLATULENCE chance** at fart-trigger checks. Cosmetic sound behavior; no configured poison cloud, reflection, or stun.
